summary: Backend-only testing of StayOS Phase-1 Property/Policy foundation on the NestJS API (http://localhost:3001/api/v1). New pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_property_policies_billing_config.py (36 tests: 35 PASSED, 1 FAILED - unhandled FK 500). Verified: deposit policies (GROUP_DEPOSIT FIXED_AMOUNT 5000 -> 200 with charge* null; INDIVIDUAL_DEPOSIT PERCENTAGE 20 -> 200; 101 -> 400; NONE without value -> 200 with value 0; missing depositMode -> 400), charge policies (CANCELLATION FIRST_NIGHT + cutoff 24 -> 200 with deposit* null; PERCENTAGE 150 -> 400; EARLY_CHECK_IN FIRST_NIGHT -> 400; LATE_CHECKOUT FIXED_AMOUNT 750 + grace 60 -> 200; NO_SHOW FIRST_NIGHT -> 200; missing/valueless charge modes -> 400), strict cross-field rejection (chargeMode on deposit type, depositMode on charge type, cancellationCutoffHours on NO_SHOW, graceMinutes on CANCELLATION -> all 400), whitelist rejection of unknown fields (policies + billing-config -> 400), invalid :policyType FOO -> 400 on GET and PUT, invalid property UUID -> 400, unknown property -> 404, unauthenticated -> 401. GET /policies returns array of 5 persisted policies (no _id leakage, correct propertyId). Billing config PUT/GET persists invoicePrefix/nextInvoiceNumber/resetSequenceYearly/financialYearStartMonth/defaultHsnSac; month 13 -> 400, nextInvoiceNumber 0 -> 400, bad prefix chars -> 400, config unchanged after invalid attempts. GET /properties/:id returns businessDayCutOffTime '00:00:00'. RBAC verified: readonly@stayos.local gets 403 on both PUTs and 200 on both GETs. DB schema verified directly (property_policies with CHECK/partial-unique constraints, property_billing_configs row, reservations.policy_snapshot/tax_snapshot jsonb nullable, properties.business_day_cut_off_time default '00:00:00'). Targeted jest specs for policies + billing-config: 20/20 passed. Prior regression suite test_group_room_mix_deposit.py: 5/5 passed.

critical.issue: Passing a syntactically valid but non-existent ratePlanId returns HTTP 500 {code:'DATABASE_ERROR'} (unhandled FK violation on FK_property_policies_rate_plan_id). Should be 400/404 with VALIDATION_ERROR/NOT_FOUND. Repro: body {"depositMode":"NONE","ratePlanId":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000"}.

minor.issue: Validation messages are group-specific because the group normalizer is reused: INDIVIDUAL_DEPOSIT with PERCENTAGE 101 returns 'Group booking deposit percentage must be greater than 0 and at most 100.' Misleading for individual/rate-plan deposits.
Returns 200 with data:null for a policy type that was never configured (e.g. EARLY_CHECK_IN). Acceptable, but inconsistent with the 404 used for unknown properties; document or return 404.
No way to read a rate-plan-scoped policy: getOne always queries ratePlanId IS NULL and there is no query param. Rate-plan overrides can be written (once a rate plan exists) but never read back.
invoicePrefix is silently upper-cased ('inv-' -> 'INV-') by the @Transform; harmless but the client's stored value differs from what it sent with no indication.

Dual source of truth: after setting GROUP_DEPOSIT to FIXED_AMOUNT/5000 in property_policies, GET /properties/:id still reports groupBookingDepositPolicyType 'NONE' and the group-room-mix suggestions endpoint keeps using the legacy properties.group_booking_deposit_policy_* columns. Foundation-only for now, but the two stores can diverge indefinitely.

action_items: Handle non-existent/foreign ratePlanId in PoliciesService.upsert (validate the rate plan belongs to the property) so it returns 400/404 instead of a 500 DATABASE_ERROR.
Make deposit validation messages policy-type aware (or wrap the group normalizer) so INDIVIDUAL_DEPOSIT errors don't say 'Group booking deposit'.
Decide and document the GET single-policy contract (200 + null vs 404) and add a way to read rate-plan-scoped policies.
Plan the migration path so property_policies becomes the single source of truth over properties.group_booking_deposit_policy_* (currently divergent).
critical_code_review_comments: policies.service.ts upsert() blanks all mode/value columns before dispatch - good for strictness - but cancellationCutoffHours/graceMinutes are only re-applied when explicitly provided, so an upsert that omits them silently clears a previously configured cutoff/grace. Intentional for PUT semantics, but should be documented for API consumers.
No ownership check between ratePlanId and propertyId; a rate plan from another property would be accepted (only FK to rate_plans is enforced) - cross-tenant policy write risk.

policies.service.ts relies on DTO whitelist for unknown-field rejection and on rejectFields for cross-type fields; both work today, but rejectFields only checks undefined - an explicit null (e.g. {"chargeMode":null}) is silently accepted and ignored on a deposit policy instead of being rejected.

BillingConfigService.get() returns an unsaved entity built from DEFAULTS when no row exists, so GET returns an object without id/createdAt; clients should not assume the resource is persisted after a GET.
seed_data_creation: Left idempotent upserts in place on property 9d0680c0-89b0-41d5-ae06-b08cd7bedeae: GROUP_DEPOSIT FIXED_AMOUNT 5000, INDIVIDUAL_DEPOSIT PERCENTAGE 20, CANCELLATION FIRST_NIGHT cutoff 24, NO_SHOW FIRST_NIGHT, LATE_CHECKOUT FIXED_AMOUNT 750 grace 60; billing config INV-/1/true/4/996311.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_property_policies_billing_config.py -v -p no:randomly. Base URL/property overridable via STAYOS_API_URL / STAYOS_PROPERTY_ID env vars. Only expected failure is test_unknown_rate_plan_id_should_not_500 (open bug). Property 9d0680c0-... has NO rate_plans rows, so rate-plan-scoped policy happy path is untestable until a rate plan is seeded. Responses wrapped as {success,data}; login returns 201.
rca_of_the_issue: The 500 comes from PoliciesService.upsert persisting dto.ratePlanId without verifying the rate plan exists / belongs to the property; Postgres raises FK_property_policies_rate_plan_id violation which the global filter maps to DATABASE_ERROR (500). Fix: look up the rate plan by {id, propertyId} and throw BadRequest/NotFound when absent.
